Mimrylo (rusfertide) 
 
  
  
Prior Authorization Guideline 
 
  
Guideline ID 
GL-756212  
Guideline Name 
Mimrylo (rusfertide)  
Formulary 
• 
Medicaid - Arizona (AZM, AZMREF, AZMDDD)  
 
 
Guideline Note: 
Effective Date: 
11/1/2026  
 
 
 
 
1 .  Criteria 
 
Product Name:Mimrylo  
Approval Length 
12 month(s)  
Therapy Stage 
Initial Authorization  
Guideline Type 
Prior Authorization  
 
 
Approval Criteria    
 
1 - Submission of medical records (e.g., chart notes) confirming ALL of the following:  
 
 1.1 Diagnosis of polycythemia vera  


--- PDF page 1166 ---
Page 1166 
 
AND 
 
 1.2 Patient has absolute erythrocytosis (i.e., hemoglobin > 16.5 g/dL for men or hemoglobin > 
16.0 g/dL for women, or hematocrit > 49% for men or hematocrit > 48% for women)  
 
AND 
 
 1.3 One of the following:  
• 
Presence of JAK2 V617F or JAK2 exon 12 mutation  
• 
Patient has subnormal serum erythropoietin level  
 
AND 
 
 1.4 Requested drug will be used for the treatment of erythrocytosis  
 
AND 
 
 1.5 Patient has inadequate hematocrit control with frequent phlebotomy or has intolerance to 
phlebotomy  
 
AND 
 
2 - Prescribed by or in consultation with one of the following:  
• 
Hematologist  
• 
Oncologist  
 
Product Name:Mimrylo  
Approval Length 
12 month(s)  
Therapy Stage 
Reauthorization  
Guideline Type 
Prior Authorization  


--- PDF page 1167 ---
Page 1167 
 
 
Approval Criteria    
 
1 - Patient does not show evidence of progressive disease while on therapy (e.g., hematocrit 
levels < 45%)

Date
